report_or_finding: 9/11 Commission Final Report Chapter 7 — Thumairy assistance negative finding
investigator: National Commission on Terrorist Attacks Upon the United States
employer_controller: Independent bipartisan commission created by U.S. law
exact_wording: we have not found evidence that Thumairy provided assistance to the two operatives.
scope: Whether Fahad al-Thumairy provided assistance to Nawaf al-Hazmi and Khalid al-Mihdhar, based on the leads available to the Commission by publication in July 2004.
records_reviewed: FBI electronic communications and reports cited in Chapter 7 notes
FBI and Commission interviews cited in Chapter 7 notes
telephone/contact records described in Chapter 7 notes
records_unavailable: The Commission stated that Hazmi and Mihdhar's activities during their first two weeks in the United States were not fully ascertained.
workpapers_status: Underlying Commission interview memoranda and cited agency records are only partly represented in the public final report; source-by-source mapping remains in progress.
competing_findings: The 2016 Operation Encore EC records later FBI rereview of Thumairy-related contacts, communications, and possible facilitation questions.
notes: This is a scoped institutional negative finding, not a timeless factual assertion. Later investigative activity does not automatically negate it; the evidence sets must be compared.
